name: @geoquery/utils
description: Shared test fixtures for the geoquery TypeScript packages
//: Private on purpose: every export here is test infrastructure that runs under `bun test`, and nothing in a published package may depend on it. `main` points at `src/` rather than `dist/` because bun resolves TypeScript directly, and building a `.d.ts` for a package only `bun` ever loads would be a step whose only failure mode is the two halves disagreeing about the same types.
